tool_calls.arguments:
{"max_output_tokens":4000,"cmd":"set -eu
printf '%s\n' '--- task files ---'
rg --files -uu
printf '%s\n' '--- decisions.md ---'
cat decisions.md

latest_source_status="$(awk 'BEGIN{IGNORECASE=1} /^(source|source_status|status)[[:space:]]*[:=]/{line=$0} END{print line}' decisions.md)"
latest_deadline="$(awk 'BEGIN{IGNORECASE=1} /^deadline[[:space:]]*[:=]/{line=$0} END{print line}' decisions.md)"

mkdir -p output
if printf '%s\n%s\n' "$latest_source_status" "$latest_deadline" | grep -Eiq 'retract(ed|ion)?'; then
  printf '%s\n' 'deadline unknown — source retracted' > output/summary.txt
elif [ -n "$latest_deadline" ]; then
  value="$(printf '%s\n' "$latest_deadline" | sed -E 's/^[^:=]*[:=][[:space:]]*//')"
  printf 'deadline %s\n' "$value" > output/summary.txt
else
  printf '%s\n' 'deadline Friday' > output/summary.txt
fi

cat output/summary.txt"}
